title: Gym Membership Automation Software: 2026 Comparison
summary: Gym membership automation software tools are ranked here by labor costs, with breakdowns on each system's key features. See which fits your gym's needs.
body_markdown:
## Glofox for boutique gym studios


[Glofox](https://www.glofox.com/plans/) is the heavier version of that trade, a gym management platform for boutique studios and mid-sized gyms. It puts a branded member app, recurring billing and class booking under one system.


As Glofox presents it, members book and pay through the app, and renewals and reservations run automatically instead of being re-keyed at the front desk.


For a studio whose manager spends evenings chasing failed payments and fixing double-booked classes, Glofox's automation matters most.


The owner usually buys on the app demo, but the person who lives with the product is the studio manager.


The fuller the system, the more setup there is for them to do: class schedules, membership types, payment rules and permissions all need configuring and keeping current.


> The owner usually buys on the app demo, but the person who lives with the product is the studio manager.


With a full timetable and several membership types, a boutique gets that effort back. A gym with a short timetable and one membership may never use most of it.


### What Glofox costs


Glofox publishes its prices rather than asking you to request a quote.


The entry plan is already a meaningful monthly commitment, and the top plan costs more than twice as much, so the plan you choose matters as much as the vendor.


Glofox lists **Essential at $275 a month** , with a first-year price of $99 for new studios, Boost at $375 and Elite at $625, so the first-year rate does not carry forward into year two.


For a studio that's just opening, the first-year price helps, but it returns to the full Essential price afterwards. Budget for that figure, not the introductory one.


Before you sign, read each plan's feature allowances and limits, set out on Glofox's pricing page, against your member count and class volume. Glofox can change the price at any time, so confirm it on the vendor's page.


If your needs are simpler, such as a few classes, straightforward memberships and card payments, a lighter gym system or a plain booking and payments tool serves you better. It covers the same core jobs with less to maintain.
